title: Behind Skybax Rider
content: If you click on this image to make it bigger, it will tell you a lot of behind-the-scenes stuff about the painting, which I did back in 1990.The image appears inDinotopia: A Land Apart from Time, which is finally back in print in a spectacular 20th anniversary edition, with 32 pages of new material (including an illustrated afterword that I wrote about the making of the book).You can get it signed and personalized from me at my website.Orstop by Books of Wonder in New York todayand I'd love to meet you and sign your copy.
